name: docforge
description: Design and generate a repository's documentation set — docs/ tree, README, two-altitude architecture (high-level map, low-level detail, deep-dive concepts), tech-debt and constraints registers, decision records, dependency inventory, security policy, error catalogs, runbooks, plus aligned per-flow documents and Business Analyst and Product Owner audience depth. One topic, many readers: a flat file by default, promoted to a folder with per-reader deep-dive subfiles only in the same pass that writes real depth — never a folder with a promised subfile that isn't there. Written once with no duplication, at a durability level that survives code refactors, and gated on the knowledge graph and domain graph actually existing (no hand-typed flow lists). Grounded in a knowledge-graph analysis of the actual source, with git-hash provenance so staleness is checked, not guessed. Host-neutral, with multi-repo collection discovery for diligence.

entries.name: docforge
entries.description: Design and generate a repository's documentation set — the docs/ tree, README, two-altitude architecture (high-level map, low-level detail, deep-dive concepts), tech-debt and constraints registers, decision records (ADRs), a known-limitations register, a third-party dependency inventory, security policy, API error catalogs, runbooks, plus aligned per-flow documents and Business Analyst and Product Owner audience depth. Organizes by topic, not audience: each flow or subsystem is a flat file by default, promoted to a folder with per-reader deep-dive subfiles only in the same pass that writes real depth, every fact written once (no duplication) and at a behaviour level that survives code refactors. Grounds every document in a knowledge-graph analysis of the actual source before writing — flows and product content are hard-gated on the domain graph existing, never hand-typed — and stamps git-hash provenance so staleness is checked, not guessed. Host-neutral — works on any git host and never hardcodes one forge's paths, and discovers child repos before any multi-repo review.
